```{r}

params$sav_file
params$ex_cond
```

```{python}
import pyreadstat
import numpy as np
import traceback
filename = r.params['sav_file']
x = r.params['x']
ex = r.params['ex']
ex_cond = r.params['ex_cond']
```


```{python}
df, meta = pyreadstat.read_sav(filename)
df, meta
```


```{python}

new_var_exists = x in df.columns.values.tolist()

if not new_var_exists:
    df[[x]] = None
try:
    if_vec = df.eval(ex); print(if_vec)
    else_vec = df.eval(x); print(else_vec)
    cond_bool = df.eval(ex_cond); print(cond_bool)
    df[x] = np.where(cond_bool, if_vec, else_vec)
    if not new_var_exists:
    # append new variable to label dict:
        meta.column_labels.append(None)

# traceback isn't defined for this dtype :(
except Exception:
    traceback.print_exc()


```
